20: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)

22: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
23: {
24:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
25:   uint32_t order;

29: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;

40: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
41: {
42:   return getreg32(up_cpu_index() == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
43:                                        BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS);

46: static void mbox_clear_errors(int cpu)
47: {
48:   uintptr_t cfg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG;
49:   uint32_t config = getreg32(cfg);
50:   uint32_t errors = config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
51: 
52:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
53:     {
54:       g_stats.write_error++;
55:     }
56: 
57:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
58:     {
59:       g_stats.read_error++;
60:     }
61: 
62:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
63:     {
64:       g_stats.write_full++;
65:     }
66: 
67:   if (errors != 0)
68:     {
69:       putreg32((config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, cfg);
70:     }
71: }

73: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
74:                                 uint32_t length)
75: {
76:   if (source != 0)
77:     {
78:       g_stats.bad_source++;
79:       return false;
80:     }
81: 
82:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
83:     {
84:       g_stats.bad_length++;
85:       return false;
86:     }
87: 
88:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
89:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
90:     {
91:       g_stats.bad_address++;
92:       return false;
93:     }
94:

98: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
99: {
100:   uintptr_t status;
101:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
102: 
103:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
104:     {
105:       return -EINVAL;
106:     }
107: 
108: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
109:   if (cpu == 1 && (destination != 1 || data[1] != 0))
110:     {
111:       return -EPERM;
112:     }
113: #endif
114: 
115:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
116:    * receive FIFO status register.
117:    */
118: 
119:   status = destination == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
120:             destination == 1 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
121:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
122:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
123:     {

128:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA0);
129:   putreg32(data[1], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 :
130:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA1);
131:   putreg32(destination, cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TID :
132:                                   BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TID);

138:   unsigned int i;
139: 
140:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
141:     {
142:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
143:         {
144:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
145:         }
146:     }
147: 
148:   return NULL;
149: }
150: 
151: static bool mbox_priority_message(
152:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
153: {
154:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
155: 
156:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
157: }
158: 
159: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
160: {
161:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
162:   unsigned int i;
163: 
164:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
165:     {
166:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
167: 
168:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
169:         {
170:           continue;
171:         }
172: 
173:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
174:         {
175:           oldest = desc;
176:         }
177:     }
178: 
179:   return oldest;
180: }
181: 
182: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
183: {
184:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
185:   int ret;
186: 
187:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
188:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
189:    */
190: 
191:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
192:     {
193:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
194:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
195:       g_processing_order = 0;
196:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
197:         {
198:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
199:           break;
200:         }
201: 
202:       desc->used = false;
203:     }
204: 
205:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
206:     {
207:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
208:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
209:       g_processing_order = 0;
210:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
211:         {
212:           break;
213:         }
214: 
215:       desc->used = false;
216:     }
217: }
218: 
219: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
220: {
221:   uintptr_t rdata0;
222:   uintptr_t rdata1;
223:   uintptr_t sidreg;
224:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
225: 
226:   (void)irq;
227:   (void)context;
228:   (void)arg;
229: 
230:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
231:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
232:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
233:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
234: 
235:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
236:     {
237:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
238:       uint32_t address;
239:       uint32_t length;
240:       uint8_t source;
241: 
242:       if (cpu == 0)
243:         {
244:           mbox_process_desc();
245:         }
246: 
247:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
248:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
249:         {
250:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
251:           break;
252:         }
253: 
254:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
255:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
256:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
257: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
258:       if (length == 0)
259:         {
260:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
261:             {
262:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
263:             }
264:           else
265:             {
266:               if (cpu == 0)
267:                 {
268:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
269:                 }
270:             }
271: 
272:           continue;
273:         }
274: #endif
275: 
276:       if (cpu != 0)
277:         {
278:           continue;
279:         }
280: 
281:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
282:         {
283:           continue;
284:         }
285: 
286:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
287:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
288:              sizeof(desc->message));
289:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
290:       desc->used = true;
291:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
292:       mbox_process_desc();
293:     }
294: 
295:   if (cpu == 0)
296:     {
297:       mbox_process_desc();
298:     }
299: 
300:   return OK;
301: }
302: 
303: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
304: {
305:   g_callback = callback;
306: }
307: 
308: void bk7258_mbox_kick_rx(void)
309: {
310:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
311: 
312:   (void)bk7258_mbox_irq(0, NULL, NULL);
313:   up_irq_restore(flags);
314: }
315: 
316: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
317: {
318:   unsigned int i;
319: 
320:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
321:     {
322:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
323:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
324:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
325:         {
326:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
327:         }
328:     }
329: }
330: 
331: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
332: {
333:   irqstate_t flags;
334: 
335:   if (stats == NULL)
336:     {
337:       return;
338:     }
339: 
340:   flags = up_irq_save();
341:   *stats = g_stats;
342:   up_irq_restore(flags);
343: }
344: 
345: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
346: {
347:   int ret;
348: 
349:   if (g_mbox_ready)
350:     {
351:       return OK;
352:     }
353: 
354:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
355:   g_rx_order = 0;
356:   g_processing_order = 0;
357:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
358: 
359:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
360:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
361:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
362:    */
363: 
364:   putreg32(2u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
365:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
366:             BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
367:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
368: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
369:   putreg32(5u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
370:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
371:             BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG);
372:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH2_FIFO_CFG);
373: #endif
374:   modifyreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
375:   mbox_clear_errors(0);
376: 
377:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
378:   if (ret < 0)
379:     {
380:       return ret;
381:     }
382: 
383:   g_mbox_ready = true;
384: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
385:   g_mbox_smp_ready = true;
386: #endif
387:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
388:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
389:   return OK;
390: }
391: 
392: bool bk7258_mbox_smp_ready(void)
393: {
394: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
395:   return g_mbox_ready && g_mbox_smp_ready;
396: #else
397:   return false;
398: #endif
399: }

401: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
402: int bk7258_mbox_secondary_init(void)
403: {
404:   if (!g_mbox_ready || !g_mbox_smp_ready || up_cpu_index() != 1)

406:       return -EAGAIN;
407:     }
408: 
409:   mbox_clear_errors(1);
410:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
411:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
412:   return OK;
413: }

106: void __attribute__((noinline, target("general-regs-only")))
107: bk7258_cpu_private_initialize(bool primary)
108: {
109:   const size_t region_count = sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions) /
110:                               sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions[0]);
111: 
112:   modifyreg32(NVIC_CPACR, 0,
113:               NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(10) | NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(11));
114:   UP_DSB();
115:   UP_ISB();
116: 
117:   putreg32(0, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
118:   putreg32(0x00000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
119:   putreg32(0x0fffffe3u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
120:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
121:   putreg32(0x10000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
122:   putreg32(0xefffffe1u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
123:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x00);
124:   UP_DSB();
125:   UP_ISB();
126: 
127:   putreg32((uintptr_t)__ram_vectors_start, NVIC_VECTAB);
128:   UP_DSB();
129:   UP_ISB();
130: 
131: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
132:   {
133:     const uint32_t hardware_regions =
134:       (getreg32(MPU_TYPE) & MPU_TYPE_DREGION_MASK) >>
135:       MPU_TYPE_DREGION_SHIFT;
136: 
137:     if (hardware_regions < region_count)
138:       {
139:         for (; ; )
140:           {
141:             __asm__ volatile("wfi");
142:           }
143:       }
144: 
145:     mpu_reset();
146:     mpu_initialize(g_bk7258_mpu_regions, region_count, false, true);
147: 
148:   }
149: #endif
150: 
151:   (void)primary;
152: }

154: static void __attribute__((used, noinline, noreturn,
155:                            target("general-regs-only")))
156: bk7258_start(void)
157: {
158:   const uint8_t *src;
159:   uint8_t *dest;
160: 
161:   /* Enable CP10/CP11 before code compiled for the hard-float ABI can use the
162:    * floating-point extension.
163:    */
164: 
165:   modifyreg32(NVIC_CPACR, 0,
166:               NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(10) | NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(11));
167:   UP_DSB();
168:   UP_ISB();
169: 
170:   for (src = _eronly, dest = _sdata; dest < _edata; )
171:     {
172:       *dest++ = *src++;
173:     }
174: 
175:   for (dest = _sbss; dest < _ebss; )
176:     {
177:       *dest++ = 0;
178:     }
179: 
180:   for (src = __ram_vectors_load, dest = __ram_vectors_start;
181:        dest < __ram_vectors_end; )
182:     {
183:       *dest++ = *src++;
184:     }

196:   arm_earlyserialinit();
197: #endif

199:   nx_start();
200:   for (; ; )
201:     {
202:     }
203: }

213:       "ldr r0, =__idle_stack_base\n"
214:       "msr msplim, r0\n"

50: /****************************************************************************
51:  * Name: nx_idle_trampoline
52:  *
53:  * Description:
54:  *   This is the common start-up logic for the IDLE task for CPUs 1 through
55:  *   (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).  Having a start-up function such as this for the
56:  *   IDLE is not really an architectural necessity.  It is used only for
57:  *   symmetry with how other threads are started (see nxtask_start() and
58:  *   pthread_start()).
59:  *
60:  * Input Parameters:
61:  *   None.
62:  *
63:  * Returned Value:
64:  *   This function does not return.
65:  *
66:  ****************************************************************************/
67: 
68: void nx_idle_trampoline(void)
69: {
70: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION_SWITCH
71:   FAR struct tcb_s *tcb = this_task();
72: 
73:   /* Announce that the IDLE task has started */
74: 
75:   sched_note_start(tcb);
76: #endif
77: 
78:   /* wait until cpu0 in idle() */
79: 
80:   while (!OSINIT_IDLELOOP());
81: 
82:   sched_unlock();
83: 
84:   /* Enter the IDLE loop */
85: 
86:   sinfo("CPU%d: Beginning Idle Loop\n", this_cpu());
87: 
88:   for (; ; )
89:     {
90:       /* Perform any processor-specific idle state operations */
91: 
92:       up_idle();
93:     }
94: }
95: 
96: /****************************************************************************
97:  * Name: nx_smp_start
98:  *
99:  * Description:
100:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
101:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion
102:  *   of the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal
103:  *   multitasking, the additional CPUs would be started by calling this
104:  *   function.
105:  *
106:  * Input Parameters:
107:  *   None
108:  *
109:  * Returned Value:
110:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
111:  *
112:  * Assumption:
113:  *   Runs before the full initialization sequence has completed.  Runs after
114:  *   all OS facilities are set up, but before multi-tasking has been started.
115:  *
116:  ****************************************************************************/
117: 
118: int nx_smp_start(void)
119: {
120:   int ret;
121:   int cpu;
122: 
123:   /* Flush dcache before start other CPUs. */
124: 
125:   up_flush_dcache_all();
126: 
127:   /* Start all of the other CPUs.  CPU0 is already running. */
128: 
129:   for (cpu = 1; cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; cpu++)
130:     {
131:       /* Start the CPU */
132: 
133:       ret = up_cpu_start(cpu);
134:       if (ret < 0)
135:         {
136:           serr("ERROR: Failed to start CPU%d: %d\n", cpu, ret);
137:           return ret;
138:         }
139:     }
140: 
141:   return OK;
142: }
143: 
144: #endif /* CONFIG_SMP */

367: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)

369:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
370:   struct pwc_message message;
371:   unsigned int next;
372:   irqstate_t flags;
373: 
374:   if (bytes == NULL)
375:     {
376:       return;

379:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
380:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
381:   if (next == g_tail)
382:     {
383:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
384:       return;
385:     }
386: 
387:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
388:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
389:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
390:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
391:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
392:   g_head = next;
393:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
394:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);

397: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
398: {
399:   int ret;
400: 
401:   (void)argc;
402:   (void)argv;
403:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
404:   g_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
405:   g_worker_ready = ret >= 0;
406:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
407:   if (ret < 0)
408:     {
409:       return -EXDEV;
410:     }
411: 
412:   for (;;)
413:     {
414:       struct pwc_message message;
415:       irqstate_t flags;
416: 
417:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
418:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
419:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
420:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
421:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
422:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
423:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
424:         {
425:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
426:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
427:             if (g_psram_power_waiting &&
428:                 message.param1 == g_psram_power_expected_state)
429:               {
430:                 g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
431:                 g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
432:                 g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
433:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
434:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
435:               }
436:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
437:             break;
438: 
439:           case PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD:
440:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
441:             if (g_openvela_ready_waiting &&
442:                 message.param1 == g_openvela_ready_expected)
443:               {
444:                 g_openvela_ready_echo = message.param1;
445:                 g_openvela_ready_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
446:                 g_openvela_ready_version = message.param3;
447:                 g_openvela_ready_received = true;
448:                 g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
449:                 nxsem_post(&g_openvela_ready_sem);
450:               }
451:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
452:             break;
453: 
454: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
455:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
456:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
457:               {
458:                 ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
459:                         PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
460:                         PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
461:                         bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
462:                 if (ret != OK)
463:                   {
464:                     printf("PWC: PSRAM malloc state response failed, "
465:                            "error=%d\n", ret);
466:                   }
467:               }
468:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
469:               {
470:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
471: 
472:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
473:               }
474:             break;
475: 
476:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
477:             bk7258_psram_dump();
478:             break;
479: 
480:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
481:             {
482: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
483:               ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
484:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
485:                       (uint32_t)-ENOTSUP, 0);
486: #else
487:               int shutdown_ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
488: 
489:               ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
490:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
491:                       shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
492:                                           PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
493:                       0);
494: #endif
495:               if (ret != OK)
496:                 {
497:                   printf("PWC: recovery response failed, error=%d\n", ret);
498:                 }
499:             }
500:             break;
501: #endif
502: 
503:           default:
504:             break;
505:         }
506:     }
507:   return 0;
508: }

1: # BK7258 OpenVela AP 双核 SMP、480 MHz 与电源管理方案
2: 
3: > 文档状态：2026-08-05 源码审计后的实施基线。本文以当前比赛仓库、最终
4: > OpenVela `.config`、`bk_avdk_smp` CP/AP 源码和实板长期运行日志为依据。
5: > 本文描述目标实现，不表示 CPU2、480 MHz 或低压睡眠已经完成实板验收。
6: > 任何与本文冲突的历史设计，以当前源码、最终配置和实板证据为准。
7: 
8: ## 1. 目标与固定结论
9: 
10: 目标是在 BK7258 上运行一个 NuttX SMP 实例：物理 CPU1 和 CPU2 共同执行同一个
11: OpenVela `nuttx.bin`，目标 AP 核频率为 480 MHz。物理 CPU0 继续运行 Armino CP，
12: 并继续拥有全芯片电源、DPLL、核心/总线时钟、电压、PSRAM PHY、硬件 WDT 和
13: CPU1 电源生命周期。
14: 
15: 正式架构固定为：
16: 
17: | 物理核 | NuttX 编号 | 角色 | 目标频率 |
18: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
19: | CPU0 | 不可见 | Armino CP，电源/频率执行者 | 240 MHz（480 MHz档位下） |
20: | CPU1 | 0 | OpenVela AP primary、系统 tick、CP transport owner | 480 MHz |
21: | CPU2 | 1 | OpenVela AP secondary、通用 SMP 调度 | 480 MHz |
22: 
23: BK7258 的 `PM_CPU_FRQ_480M` 不是三核都运行 480 MHz。原厂档位意图是：
24: 
25: ```text
26: core source: 480 MHz
27: CPU0:       240 MHz
28: CPU1:       480 MHz
29: CPU2:       480 MHz
30: bus:        240 MHz
31: ```
32: 
33: 当前 HAL 已明确写入 480 MHz source、CPU0 `/2` 和 CPU1/CPU2 `/1`，但
34: `sys_hal_core_bus_clock_ctrl()` 虽接收 `ckdiv_bus`，实际只改 `CLK_DIV_REG0[3:0]`
35: 的 core divider，没有写 bit 6 的 bus divider。因此 CPU0/CPU1/CPU2 目标值有源码
36: 依据，bus 240 MHz 仍是必须通过寄存器和实测确认的目标，不能只凭档位注释验收。
37: 
38: 依据为：
39: 
40: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/modules/pm.h:346-353`
41: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:571-658`
42: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c:2218-2283`
43: 
44: 必须同时接受以下结论：
45: 
46: 1. 不能只打开 `CONFIG_SMP`。CPU2 reset/vector、核 ID、每核中断栈、IPI、
47:    SMP atomic 和驱动并发都必须实现。
48: 2. 不能只把 AP `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ` 改为 480 MHz。CP 是共享核心时钟的
49:    唯一执行者，必须在释放 CPU1 reset 前建立 480 MHz vote，并在 AP 停止后释放。
50: 3. 首版 480 MHz SMP 运行期间禁止 runtime DVFS。CPU1/CPU2 的核心时钟变化会直接
51:    改变 SysTick；没有 pre-change/post-change 协议和时间补偿时，运行中改频会破坏
52:    timeout、sleep、scheduler tick 和 heartbeat。
53: 4. `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y` 是必需配置，不是可选优化。当前 32 位配置已经造成
54:    可重复的长期静置重启。
55: 5. CPU2 不需要独立镜像或分区。CPU1/CPU2 共享 `app1.bin`、地址空间和调度器；
56:    CPU2 只需要同一镜像内的 secondary boot vector。
57: 6. CPU2 启动失败时不得静默降级为单核。`CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=2` 下必须 fail-stop，
58:    否则 NuttX per-CPU 和调度器状态不完整。
59: 7. 首版只支持普通 idle WFI。CP coordinated low-voltage、CPU1/CPU2 掉电、CPU2
60:    hotplug 和 runtime DVFS 必须在独立阶段完成，不得和首次 SMP bring-up 混合。
61: 
62: ## 2. 当前源码事实与历史方案修正
63: 
64: ### 2.1 当前可复用基线
65: 
66: 正式 OpenVela 代码所有权目录是：
67: 
68: ```text
69: contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/
70: ```
71: 
72: 当前代码已经具备：
73: 
74: - CPU1 reset、C runtime、SAU、FPU、MPU 和 RAM runtime vector。
75: - Mailbox v2 channel 1、transport ACK/reset/probe、Mailbox UART 全双工 console。
76: - AP power-up indication、2 秒 heartbeat、PWC ready 和 PSRAM power vote。
77: - 16 MiB PSRAM non-cacheable/XN 映射、AP 独立 heap 和四个媒体 pool。
78: - GPIO、PWM、I2C、QSPI、camera、基础 Wi-Fi IPC 代码。
79: - `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 打包链和单个 `app1.bin`。
80: 
81: 当前还没有：
82: 
83: - `CONFIG_SMP=y`、CPU2 secondary entry、`up_cpu_start()`。
84: - 逻辑 CPU ID、每核中断栈、CPU2 私有 MPU/NVIC 初始化。
85: - AP 内部 channel 1/2 raw Mailbox IPI。
86: - 适合 BK7258 SRAM exclusive 限制的 NuttX atomic backend。
87: - CP 侧 OpenVela AP 480 MHz 生命周期 vote。
88: - OpenVela 双核 coordinated low-voltage 和恢复时间补偿。
89: 
90: ### 2.2 对旧版方案的修正
91: 
92: | 旧说法 | 当前结论 |
93: | --- | --- |
94: | “不改变 CPU0/CP 固件” | 错误。480 MHz 生命周期、CPU2 电源域和低压策略必须修改 CP。协议兼容保持不变不等于 CP 源码不改。 |
95: | “首版固定 120 MHz” | 已被实板否定。当前 CP 将共享核心时钟降至 60 MHz；正式目标改为 CP 保证的 480 MHz。 |
96: | “Mailbox IRQ 到 board late 才注册” | 已过时。当前 `arm_serialinit()` 初始化 logical transport、Mailbox UART，并启动 physical mailbox；SMP 应在此基础上增加 channel 2。 |
97: | “PSRAM allocator/PWC 是占位分支” | 已过时。当前 `bk7258_psram.c` 已建立独立 allocator 和 shutdown 状态机，`bk7258_pm_pwc.c` 已处理 power/query/recovery。SMP 仍需审计其跨核锁和对象生命周期。 |
98: | “当前功能不含 Wi-Fi” | 已过时。当前工作树已有 Wi-Fi IPC 代码和配置；首次 SMP 调试仍应关闭 Wi-Fi 以缩小故障面，之后恢复。 |
99: | “AP_SPINLOCK 是硬件 spinlock” | 不准确。它是为 exclusive monitor 与 DMA/Audio 并发约束保留的 SRAM 区；锁仍由 LDAXR/STXR 实现。 |
100: | “CPU2 可由 CP start_cpu2_core() 启动” | 对单镜像 NuttX SMP 不适用。CP 不知道运行时 secondary vector；CPU1 在 `up_cpu_start(1)` 中写 CPU2 vector 并释放 reset。 |
101: | “低压睡眠可沿用原 AP” | 不成立。原实现依赖 FreeRTOS SMP idle、AON WFI bits、tick 补偿和 mailbox yield；NuttX 必须重建等价状态机。 |
102: 
103: ## 3. 已确认的长期重启与频率缺陷
104: 
105: ### 3.1 32 位时间乘法溢出导致 heartbeat 永久阻塞
106: 
107: AP heartbeat worker 位于：
108: 
109: ```c
110: for (;;)
111:   {
112:     nxsig_usleep(2000000);
113:     bk7258_mbox_send_message(... IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ...);
114:   }
115: ```
116: 
117: 来源：
118: 
119: - `contest/.../chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:70-82`
120: 
121: 当前最终配置同时满足：
122: 
123: ```text
124: CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH=y
125: CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000
126: # CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64 is not set
127: ```
128: 
129: NuttX generic architecture timer 使用：
130: 
131: ```c
132: static uint64_t current_usec(void)
133: {
134:   ...
135:   return TICK2USEC(timebase) + (status.timeout - status.timeleft);
136: }
137: ```
138: 
139: `timebase` 是 32 位 `clock_t`，`TICK2USEC` 为：
140: 
141: ```c
142: #define TICK2USEC(tick) ((tick) * USEC_PER_TICK)
143: ```
144: 
145: `1000L` 在 32 位 ARM 上仍为 32 位，因此乘法在转换为 `uint64_t` 之前已经溢出。
146: 编译产物也显示只有低 32 位 `mla`，返回值高 32 位被置零。AP 时间会在：
147: 
148: ```text
149: 2^32 us = 4,294,967.296 ms AP time
150: ```
151: 
152: 提前跳回零，而不是在正常的 32 位 tick 边界回卷。跨界前创建的两秒 sleep deadline
153: 大于这个人为最大值，回卷后的时钟永远到不了 deadline，heartbeat 线程永久阻塞。
154: 
155: CP 的 heartbeat fallback timeout 为 6000 ms。实板多次日志均满足：
156: 
157: ```text
158: current - last_heartbeat = 6000 ms
159: Assert at: mb_ipc_task:298
160: ```
161: 
162: 所以重启是 CP 在 AP heartbeat 停止后执行的确定性断言，不是随机复位。
163: 
164: 必需修复：
165: 
166: ```text
167: CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y
168: ```
169: 
170: 不能只把 heartbeat 改成 busy wait、分段 sleep 或增大 CP timeout。这些只能隐藏一个
171: 调用者，Mailbox worker、semaphore timeout 和其他 watchdog deadline 仍会失效。
172: 
173: ### 3.2 CP 60 MHz 与 AP 120 MHz 配置不一致
174: 
175: 当前 AP SysTick 使用：
176: 
177: ```c
178: systick_initialize(true, CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ, -1);
179: ```
180: 
181: AP 配置是 120 MHz，但 CP 配置和初始化代码会执行：
182: 
183: ```text
184: CONFIG_CPU_DEFAULT_FREQ_60M=y
185: bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT, PM_CPU_FRQ_60M)
186: ```
187: 
188: 而 60 MHz 档位同时影响 CPU0、CPU1、CPU2 和 bus。结果是 AP 以 120 MHz 计算的
189: 1 ms SysTick 实际约为 2 ms，2 秒 heartbeat 实际约为 4 秒。
190: 
191: 这也精确解释了重启为何发生在约 2 小时 23 分，而不是约 1 小时 11 分：
192: 
193: ```text
194: 4,294.967296 s * (120 / 60) = 8,589.934592 s
195: ```
196: 
197: 实板在约 `8,594.5 s` assert，差值位于最后一帧 heartbeat 到 6 秒 timeout 的窗口。
198: 
199: ### 3.3 CP heartbeat 配置符号错误
200: 
201: CP heartbeat 代码检查 `CONFIG_WDT_EN`，当前生成配置实际使用 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 和
202: `CONFIG_INT_WDT_PERIOD_MS=8000`。所以最终固件走的是 `2000 * 3 = 6000 ms` fallback。
203: 
204: 应将 CP 条件改为实际 watchdog 配置符号，并明确 heartbeat timeout 策略。但即使改成
205: 8 秒，也不能替代 AP 时间和频率修复。
206: 
207: ## 4. 电源、频率与核生命周期所有权
208: 
209: ### 4.1 所有权表
210: 
211: | 资源 | 唯一执行者 | OpenVela AP 职责 |
212: | --- | --- | --- |
213: | DPLL/core source/core divider/bus divider | CPU0/CP PM | 只声明固定 480 MHz 契约并校验结果；bus divider 未验证前不得发布 ready |
214: | VDDD/VDDDIG 高压档 | CPU0/CP PM | 不直接写 analog/PMU 电压寄存器 |
215: | CPU1 power/reset/boot offset | CPU0/CP | 发送 ready/recovery，不能直接关闭自身 |
216: | CPU2 power domain | CPU0/CP | 请求域保持 ON；不得直接改 `CPU2_PWR_DW/HALT` 绕过 CP accounting |
217: | CPU2 reset/boot offset | CPU1/AP primary | `up_cpu_start(1)` 写 secondary vector 并释放 reset |
218: | CPU2 scheduler/idle/IPI | OpenVela SMP | 完整管理 |
219: | PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟、容量检测 | CPU0/CP | 通过 PWC vote；只管理 AP allocator |
220: | SysTick 和 NuttX monotonic time | CPU1/OpenVela | 固定频率下维护；低压阶段用 AON 时间补偿 |
221: | WDT 和 heartbeat assert | CPU0/CP | AP 持续发送 heartbeat，处理 transport 错误 |
222: 
223: 这里的 ID 属于两个不同命名空间：`PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 是共享 frequency vote 表的 owner
224: slot，不是 CPU1 power-domain ID，也不存在 `PM_DEV_ID_CPU2` frequency slot。CPU1/CPU2
225: 电源必须分别使用 `PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`、`PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2`。当前 power
226: enum 中 CPU1、APP、CPU2 的值依次为17、18、19；禁止根据公共头文件中的过时数字注释
227: 硬编码 ID。
228: 
229: ### 4.2 480 MHz 启动时序
230: 
231: CP 必须在释放 CPU1 reset 之前建立 480 MHz，不能等 AP 启动后再通过 PWC 改频：
232: 
233: ```text
234: CP OpenVela AP boot transaction
235:   -> sole owner写PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 = PM_CPU_FRQ_480M
236:   -> 验证owner slot、PM cache和实际clock/voltage寄存器
237:   -> 用语义化helper确认CPU2处于reset-hold
238:   -> 获取OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold并确认domain ON
239:   -> power CPU1 domain ON
240:   -> 按34-byte CRC physical到32-byte logical规则计算CPU1 boot offset
241:   -> 用已验证的语义化helper release CPU1 reset
242:   -> CPU1 OpenVela 按 480 MHz 初始化 SysTick
243:   -> nx_start()内部调用nx_smp_start()/up_cpu_start(1)
244:   -> CPU1 设置 CPU2 secondary vector并用语义化helper release reset
245:   -> CPU2 online和双向IPI自检
246:   -> 发送IPC power-up并启动heartbeat
247:   -> 发送PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD解除CP启动等待
248:   -> 请求并验证PSRAM PWC
249:   -> 成功后发布独立的最终AP/PSRAM-ready门禁
250: ```
251: 
252: `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD` 必须先于PSRAM请求：当前CP从low-power worker启动CPU1并在同一
253: worker中等待boot-ready，PSRAM vote也由该worker处理；反向排序会造成双方互等。这里的
254: 最终ready是给上层allocator/driver的独立门禁，不能替换或延后现有boot-ready。
255: 
256: CP 侧建议增加显式配置 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M`，只在外部 OpenVela AP 构建中启用，
257: 避免改变原厂 FreeRTOS AP 的默认行为。该配置下修改：
258: 
259: - `PM_DEV_ID_CPU1` 只有一个覆盖式 byte slot，不是引用计数。480 MHz vote 必须只有

348: ### 4.4 关闭与故障回滚
349: 
350: 正常关闭或 AP recovery 的顺序必须是：
351: 
352: ```text
353: AP primary停止新任务和外设提交
354:   -> quiesce PSRAM/DMA/Mailbox UART
355:   -> 调度CPU2执行stop callback
356:   -> 屏蔽CPU2普通IRQ和IPI
357:   -> CPU2进入确认的park/WFI状态
358:   -> CPU1用语义化helper将CPU2置reset并确认不再执行
359:   -> AP释放自己的PSRAM PWC owner并等待CP ACK
360:   -> AP向CP回复recovery-ready
361:   -> CP确认CPU2 reset，释放power-only hold并确认CPU2 domain OFF
362:   -> CP停止/reset CPU1并确认CPU1 domain OFF
363:   -> CP以PM_CPU_FRQ_DEFAULT释放PM_DEV_ID_CPU1 slot
364:   -> CP按CPU档位和剩余PSRAM owner重新计算VDDDIG
365: ```
366: 
367: 当前 CP shutdown 代码仅在特定低压配置下才停止 CPU2，而且顺序是先停止 CPU1、后停止
368: CPU2。OpenVela SMP 模式必须改成上述顺序。CPU2仍在执行共享NuttX状态时，CP不能
369: 直接关闭CPU2 power；CPU1已停止后也不能再依赖CPU1去park CPU2。
370: 
371: 所有失败必须达到相同后置条件，但不能强制走同一callback路径：CPU1/CPU2不执行、只对
372: 本事务已获取的CPU2/CPU1 domain、OpenVela PSRAM owner和480M slot按反序释放。
373: 
374: - 480M/readback失败发生在CPU1 release前：CP直接撤销已获取资源，不等待AP。
375: - CPU1 boot超时：CP强制CPU1/CPU2 reset并关闭domain，不等待AP recovery。
376: - CPU2 online超时：CPU1若仍可信就强制CPU2 reset，不能依赖未online的stop callback。
377: - 只有正常recovery才使用完整AP quiesce、park和ready握手。

379: ## 5. 睡眠与低功耗分阶段方案
380: 
381: ### 5.1 阶段 P0：普通 WFI，禁止 coordinated low-voltage
382: 
383: 首次 SMP 和 480 MHz 验收只启用 per-core 普通 WFI：
384: 
385: - 增加BK7258 `up_idle()`；当前公共ARM `up_idle()`中的WFI被 `#if 0` 禁用，不能把
386:   “空闲任务在运行”误判为已经WFI。chip hook必须清 `SCB_SCR_SLEEPDEEP`，执行
387:   `DSB; WFI; ISB`，且不设置coordinated low-voltage ready bit。
388: - CP在每次OpenVela启动和recovery时显式调用
389:   `bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0)` 并检查 `BK_OK`。
390:   state 0表示AP active/not-ready，因此全芯片low-voltage条件不成立。
391: - 保持 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 关闭。
392: - 不支持 CPU1/CPU2 power-down、retention、CPU2 hotplug 或 tickless。
393: - heartbeat、Mailbox 和 SysTick 在普通 WFI 下仍可唤醒 CPU1。

395: CP 的 `PM_ENTER_LOW_VOL_MODULES_CONFIG` 包含 `PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`。启动 OpenVela
396: AP 时应显式写exit-sleep，不能依赖BSS初值；PM初始化实际上会把CPU1置为enter-sleep，
397: 而当前清除代码又受已关闭的 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 条件控制。OpenVela必须
398: 独立执行上述调用，保证未实现低压协议时CP只能进入normal sleep。
399: 
400: ### 5.2 阶段 P1：双核 coordinated low-voltage
401: 
402: 只有 P0 的 24 小时稳定性通过后，才能实现原厂 AP 的等价低压协议。原厂事实为：
403: 
404: - CP 要求 CPU1 和 CPU2 都进入 WFI，并检查 AON PMU 的
405:   `cp1_enter_wfi_state`、`cp2_enter_wfi_state`。
406: - AP 两个核分别屏蔽普通 IRQ，只保留本核 Mailbox wakeup。
407: - CP 保存并切换核心/Flash 时钟，恢复 DPLL 后再唤醒 AP。
408: - 原 AP 依赖 FreeRTOS SMP idle 和 `vPortYieldCore()`；这些调用不能直接移植到 NuttX。
409: 
410: NuttX实现必须复用现有SMP PM框架，而不是另建平行barrier：
411: 
412: 1. 启用 `CONFIG_PM=y`、选定governor、`CONFIG_PM_NDOMAINS=3` 和
413:    `CONFIG_PM_SMP_LAST_CPU_INDEX=0`；这里的0是NuttX logical CPU0/物理CPU1，不是CP。
414: 2. BK7258 `up_idle()` 调用 `pm_idle(handler)`；驱动通过 `pm_register()` 注册
415:    `struct pm_callback_s` prepare/notify callback。
416: 3. logical CPU0作为last CPU发起全局transition，禁止新任务迁移、DMA和mailbox
417:    transaction；两核运行per-CPU prepare并保存本核NVIC/SysTick状态。
418: 4. CPU2设置 `cp2_enter_wfi_state` 后进入WFI；CPU1确认CPU2已就绪。
419: 5. CPU1停止SysTick，设置 `cp1_enter_wfi_state`，通过既有sleep vote允许CP进入低压。
420: 6. CP只在两个AON WFI bit、AP sleep/clock vote和mailbox idle都满足后切换低压。
421: 7. CP恢复DPLL、经readback验证的480 MHz档位和bus后，通过Mailbox唤醒AP。
422: 8. CPU1读取AON elapsed time，恢复monotonic time和SysTick；再唤醒CPU2。
423: 9. 两核恢复NVIC和驱动callback，`pm_idle()`完成restore并恢复heartbeat。
424: 
425: 低压时间基准不能继续完全依赖core-clock SysTick。增加BK7258 strong
426: `up_timer_gettick()`/`up_timer_gettime()`，以AON RTC构建64位单调epoch；当前原厂启用
427: 64-bit AON counter，应使用稳定的low/high重读算法，不需要软件扩展32-bit wrap。必须由
428: CP契约确认32 kHz源是32000还是32768 Hz，并用64位算术换算、校准和验证回卷单调性。
429: 
430: 时间读取本身不是唤醒源。P1必须提供下一NuttX deadline的AON/CP wake：推荐启用
431: `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS=y`，实现完整的 `up_timer_tick_cancel()`/
432: `up_timer_tick_start()` 或 `up_alarm_cancel()`/`up_alarm_start()` AON compare backend。
433: 若暂时保持periodic语义，则必须编程AON wake不晚于下一1 ms tick，收益有限。恢复时先
434: 确认clock稳定，再重启SysTick；解除PM barrier前必须让logical CPU0至少执行一次timer
435: processing，使低压期间到期的sleep和watchdog立即得到处理。
436: 
437: 在 AON-backed monotonic time、双核 barrier和驱动 PM callback完成前，禁止打开 P1。

439: ### 5.3 Deep sleep
440: 
441: Deep sleep定义为 AP 上下文丢失后的完整重启，不是 NuttX suspend-to-RAM：

443: - CPU1/CPU2、NuttX heap、scheduler、Mailbox transport和PSRAM对象均视为丢失。

445: - PSRAM generation必须变化，旧对象不可复用。

249: 		case PM_RTC_DEEPSLEEP_CMD:
250: 			ret = pm_cp0_send_msg(LOW_PWR_CORE_RTC_DEEPSLEEP, cmd_buf->param1,cmd_buf->param2,cmd_buf->param3);

264: 		default:
265: 			break;
266: 	}

271: 
272: 	//if(pm_debug_mode()&0x2)

274: 		if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd != PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD)

331: static void pm_module_bootup_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
332: {
333: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
334: 	uint64_t current_tick   = 0;
335: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
336: 	{
337: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
338: 		{
339: boot_cp1:
340: 			#if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
341: 			bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
342: 			#endif
343:             bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
344: 
345: 			#if defined(RECV_LOG_FROM_MBOX)
346: 			void reset_forward_log_status(void);
347: 			// reset cpu1's log transfer status on cpu0.
348: 			reset_forward_log_status();
349: 			#endif
350: 
351:             start_cpu1_core();
352: 
353: 			previous_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
354: 			current_tick = previous_tick;
355: 			while((current_tick - previous_tick) < (PM_BOOT_CP1_WAITING_TIEM*AON_RTC_MS_TICK_CNT))
356: 			{
357: 				if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get()) // wait the cp1 response
358: 				{
359: 					break;
360: 				}
361: 				current_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
362: 			}
363: 
364: 			if(!bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
365: 			{
366: 				BK_LOGD(NULL,"cp0 boot cp1[%d] time out, boot cp1 fail!!!\r\n",s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count);
367: 
368: 				/*Reset psram*/
369: 				bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
370: 				bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
371: 
372: 				s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count++;
373: 				if(s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count < PM_BOOT_CP1_TRY_COUNT)
374: 				{
375: 					goto boot_cp1;
376: 				}
377: 				if(s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count == PM_BOOT_CP1_TRY_COUNT)
378: 				{
379: 					#if CONFIG_WDT_EN
380: 					bk_wdt_force_reboot();//try 3 times, if fail ,reboot.
381: 					#endif
382: 				}
383: 			}
384: 		}
385: 	}
386: }

474: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
475: 		s_pm_cp1_ctrl_state |= 0x1 << (module);
476: 		GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
477: 		pm_module_bootup_cpu1(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1);

490: 				pm_cp0_mailbox_send_data(PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD,0,0,0);
491: 				//pm_module_shutdown_cpu1(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1);

177: ## 3. 正确构建链条
178: 
179: 最终固件链条固定为：
180: 
181: ```text
182: OpenVela nuttx.bin
183:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
184:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
185:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
186:   -> package/all-app.bin
187: 
188: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
189:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
190: ```
191: 
192: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
193: 
194: - `ram_regions.csv`
195: - AP/CP `config`
196: - Kconfig 默认值
197: - 分区生成脚本
198: - SoC 链接脚本
199: 
200: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
201: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
202: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
203: 
204: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 SMP 工作树：
205: 
206: ```bash
207: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
208: ./build.sh \
209:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
210:   -e -Werror --cmake -j8
211: 
212: cp \
213:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
214:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
215: ```
216: 
217: 然后执行项目级 clean 和容器内完整构建：
218: 
219: ```bash
220: cd ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
221: make -C projects/app_ab clean
222: 
223: podman run --rm \
224:   --userns=keep-id \
225:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
226:   -w /armino \
227:   -e EXTRA_CFLAGS=-Werror \
228:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
229:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
230:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
231:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
232: ```
233: 
234: `make -C projects/app_ab clean`只删除`projects/app_ab/build`，不会删除
235: `build/openvela-ap.bin`。仅安装 Podman 时不要使用内部调用 Docker 的`dbuild.sh`。
236: 
237: CP 构建后先对生成配置做门禁，再恢复最小输入 fragment：
238: 
239: ```bash
240: generated=projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/config/sdkconfig.h
241: grep -q '^#define CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M 1$' "$generated"
242: grep -q '^#define CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_AP_IPV4 1$' "$generated"
243: grep -q '^#define CONFIG_GPIO_DEFAULT_SET_SUPPORT 1$' "$generated"
244: 
245: mirror=../contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp
246: cp "$mirror/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config" \
247:   projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config
248: cmp -s "$mirror/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config" \
249:   projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config
250: ```
251: 
252: 权威 config 是 6 行最小种子（包含首个空行），完整生成配置只存在于 build 目录，
253: 不回写比赛仓。
254:

256: 
257: 以下文件必须都反映同一份 16 MiB 布局：
258: 
259: ```text
260: projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
261: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/ram_regions.h
262: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv

264: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/armino/bk7258/bk7258_out.ld

272: CP_PSRAM_HEAP                 0x60700000 + 0x00020000
273: AP_PSRAM_HEAP                 0x60720000 + 0x002e0000
274: AP_PSRAM_SECTION              0x60a00000 + 0x00600000
275: PSRAM 最终边界                0x61000000
276: ```

279: 
280: ```bash
281: sha256sum \
282:   ~/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
283:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
284:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
285: 
286: cmp -s \
287:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
288:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
289: ```

291: 检查最终产物：
292: 
293: ```text
294: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin
295: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
296: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/build_summary.txt
297: ```
298: 
299: `build_summary.txt`中的 AP 内存统计来自 Armino AP 占位镜像，只用于检查生成的
300: 内存区域边界；它不代表最终打包的 OpenVela AP 静态占用。OpenVela AP 的静态
301: 内存应以 `nuttx.map`或`System.map`为准。

303: ## 5. OpenVela PSRAM 接入状态
304: 
305: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
306: 
307: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
308: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。
309: - USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY四个独立媒体pool。
310: - 明确排除`0x60700000..0x6071ffff` CP heap的地址检查。
311: - AP owner区域保存/恢复型alias probe，包含4/8/12 MiB测试点。
312: - `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`静态section链接保留；reset copy/clear未实现前强制0 B。
313: 
314: 本覆盖中的CP `0x7`协议要求request `param3=PM_PSRAM_PROTO_V1`；response `param1`回显
315: ON/OFF state、`param2`返回真实PSRAM driver结果、`param3`回显version。CP BOOT与
316: OpenVela使用独立owner，初始化失败不置owner bit。`0xc`已提供frequency/divider、
317: speed、voltage、CPU power/reset和PSRAM owner只读诊断；device ID和actual capacity
318: 仍未暴露，因此alias probe和整颗器件实板测试仍是容量门禁。AP board必须同步发送
319: V1 version并检查真实ret/version后才能联调；本CP侧任务未修改AP board代码。
320: 
321: PWC ready 使用两阶段契约：AP 的既有 `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD=0x5` 仅解除 CP boot
322: worker 等待，不发布最终 PWC/bridge ready。新增 `PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD=0x11` 由 mailbox
323: ISR 排入 low-power worker；`param1=1` 表示 AP 已完成 PSRAM/SMP commit，CP 只有在
324: boot stage 5、CPU1/CPU2 power、CPU2 hold、480 MHz clock 和 OpenVela PSRAM owner
325: 全部通过 readback 后才进入 stage 6 并发布 PWC ready。`param1=0` 时 `param2` 必须是
326: 真实负 errno，CP 执行 best-effort 完整 rollback。正常 recovery 的 INIT/拒绝会取消
327: shutdown 并恢复 boot vote；只有 FINISH 才进入 shutdown。CP 不实现 runtime DVFS/P1，
328: 也不在 recovery INIT 路径直接停止 CPU2。

364: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
365: 
366: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 成功 ACK、IPC power-up 和
367: PWC boot-ready 三个条件同时成立，且`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，
368: `ap_console open`才允许进入。heartbeat timeout、AP reset/power-off 和 Mailbox
369: reset/timeout都会清除门禁并请求回退到CP CLI。使用方式：
370: 
371: ```text
372: ap_console status
373: ap_console open
374: <RAW AP NSH interaction>
375: <press Ctrl-], release it, then press .>
376: ap_console status
377: ```
378: 
379: `open`在当前 CP CLI 响应经 UART TX-complete 后生效，并清 CP parser 和 UART RX；
380: RAW 模式不添加前缀。退出时按下`Ctrl-]`、松开，再按`.`；该转义不依赖行首状态。
381: 链路 reset/timeout/down 时自动清理
382: 未发送输入并回到 `CP_CLI`。`status`输出 owner/link/mode、bridge ring、MB_UART 状态、
383: active channel/sequence/command 和 drop/partial/overflow/reset/timeout 统计。

63:  * distinct from qspi_hw_t's own glb_ctrl.soft_reset/bps_clkgate fields
64:  * (which bk7258_qspi.c already touches) and from the QSPI_CLK_320M/480M

66:  * sys_drv_qspi_set_src_clk_div() in
67:  * ap/middleware/driver/qspi/qspi_driver.c, not yet ported to this repo).

69:  * while diagnosing GC9D01's persistent "cmd 0xFE timed out" symptom after
70:  * the QSPI0->QSPI1 pin-routing fix alone did not resolve it, by
71:  * cross-referencing qspi_id_init_common()'s documented call order ("1. set
72:  * clock, 2. set gpio as qspi, 3. enable interrupt") against this driver's

74:  * BK7258_I2C1_MODULE_CLK_EN's documented symptom applies here by analogy
75:  * (register writes accepted, but cmd_start_done never asserts because the
76:  * controller's internal state machine has no clock) -- not yet confirmed
77:  * on real hardware as of this comment being written; see
78:  * docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-31-gc9d01-qspi1-camera-v4l2-verification.md
79:  * section 5.1 for the diagnostic trail this was found through. */
80: #define BK7258_QSPI0_MODULE_CLK_EN (1u << 20)

16: #define BK7258_INTSTACK_ALLOC       (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS * INTSTACK_SIZE)
17: 
18: static uint64_t g_bk7258_intstacks[BK7258_INTSTACK_ALLOC / sizeof(uint64_t)]
19:   __attribute__((section(".bk_intstacks"), aligned(32)));

21: static uint64_t
22: g_bk7258_secondary_bootstack[BK7258_BOOTSTRAP_STACK_SIZE / sizeof(uint64_t)]
23:   __attribute__((used, section(".bk_bootstack"), aligned(32)));
24: 
25: int up_cpu_idlestack(int cpu, struct tcb_s *tcb, size_t stack_size)
26: {
27:   DEBUGASSERT(cpu == 1);
28:   return up_create_stack(tcb, stack_size, TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL);

30: 
31: uintptr_t up_get_intstackbase(int cpu)
32: {
33:   DEBUGASSERT((unsigned int)cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS);

48: /****************************************************************************
49:  * Name: nxsem_tickwait_slow
50:  *
51:  * Description:
52:  *   This function is a lighter weight version of sem_timedwait().  It is
53:  *   non-standard and intended only for use within the RTOS.
54:  *
55:  * Input Parameters:
56:  *   sem     - Semaphore object
57:  *   delay   - Ticks to wait from the start time until the semaphore is
58:  *             posted.  If ticks is zero, then this function is equivalent
59:  *             to sem_trywait().
60:  *
61:  * Returned Value:
62:  *   This is an internal OS interface, not available to applications, and
63:  *   hence follows the NuttX internal error return policy:  Zero (OK) is
64:  *   returned on success.  A negated errno value is returned on failure:
65:  *
66:  *     -ETIMEDOUT is returned on the timeout condition.
67:  *     -ECANCELED may be returned if the thread is canceled while waiting.
68:  *
69:  ****************************************************************************/
70: 
71: int nxsem_tickwait_slow(FAR sem_t *sem, clock_t delay)
72: {
73:   FAR struct tcb_s *rtcb = this_task();
74:   irqstate_t flags;
75:   int ret = -EINVAL;
76: 
77:   DEBUGASSERT(sem != NULL && up_interrupt_context() == false);
78: 
79:   /* Try to take the semaphore without waiting. */
80: 
81:   if (delay != 0u)
82:     {
83:       /* Start the watchdog with interrupts still disabled */
84: 
85:       flags = enter_critical_section();
86: 
87:       wd_start(&rtcb->waitdog, delay, nxsem_timeout, (uintptr_t)rtcb);
88: 
89:       /* Now perform the blocking wait */
90: 
91:       ret = nxsem_wait_slow(sem);
92: 
93:       /* We can now restore interrupts */
94: 
95:       leave_critical_section(flags);
96: 
97:       /* Stop the watchdog timer */
98: 
99:       wd_cancel(&rtcb->waitdog);
100:     }
101: 
102:   return ret;
103: }

526:   g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
527:   g_uart.sticky_status = 0;

530:   g_uart.state_pending = true;

532:   g_uart.upper_rts = false;

536:   nxsem_init(&g_uart.worker_sem, 0, 0);

40: /****************************************************************************
41:  * Name:  nxsched_add_readytorun
42:  *
43:  * Description:
44:  *   This function adds a TCB to the ready to run list.  If the currently
45:  *   active task has preemption disabled and the new TCB would cause this
46:  *   task to be pre-empted, the new task is added to the g_pendingtasks list
47:  *   instead.  The pending tasks will be made ready-to-run when preemption is
48:  *   unlocked.
49:  *
50:  * Input Parameters:
51:  *   btcb - Points to the blocked TCB that is ready-to-run
52:  *
53:  * Returned Value:
54:  *   true if the currently active task (the head of the ready-to-run list)
55:  *   has changed.
56:  *
57:  * Assumptions:
58:  * - The caller has established a critical section before calling this
59:  *   function (calling sched_lock() first is NOT a good idea -- use
60:  *   enter_critical_section()).
61:  * - The caller has already removed the input rtcb from whatever list it
62:  *   was in.
63:  * - The caller handles the condition that occurs if the head of the
64:  *   ready-to-run list is changed.
65:  *
66:  ****************************************************************************/
67: 
68: #ifndef CONFIG_SMP
69: bool nxsched_add_readytorun(FAR struct tcb_s *btcb)
70: {
71:   FAR struct tcb_s *rtcb = this_task();
72:   bool ret;
73: 
74:   /* Check if pre-emption is disabled for the current running task and if
75:    * the new ready-to-run task would cause the current running task to be
76:    * pre-empted.  NOTE that IRQs disabled implies that pre-emption is
77:    * also disabled.
78:    */
79: 
80:   if (rtcb->lockcount > 0 && rtcb->sched_priority < btcb->sched_priority)
81:     {
82:       /* Yes.  Preemption would occur!  Add the new ready-to-run task to the
83:        * g_pendingtasks task list for now.
84:        */
85: 
86:       nxsched_add_prioritized(btcb, list_pendingtasks());
87:       btcb->task_state = TSTATE_TASK_PENDING;
88:       ret = false;
89:     }
90: 
91:   /* Otherwise, add the new task to the ready-to-run task list */
92: 
93:   else if (nxsched_add_prioritized(btcb, list_readytorun()))
94:     {
95:       /* The new btcb was added at the head of the ready-to-run list.  It
96:        * is now the new active task!
97:        */
98: 
99:       DEBUGASSERT(rtcb->lockcount == 0 && !is_idle_task(btcb));
100: 
101:       btcb->task_state = TSTATE_TASK_RUNNING;
102:       btcb->flink->task_state = TSTATE_TASK_READYTORUN;
103:       up_update_task(btcb);
104:       ret = true;
105:     }
106:   else
107:     {
108:       /* The new btcb was added in the middle of the ready-to-run list */
109: 
110:       btcb->task_state = TSTATE_TASK_READYTORUN;
111:       ret = false;
112:     }
113: 
114:   return ret;
115: }
116: 
117: #else /* !CONFIG_SMP */
118: 
119: /****************************************************************************
120:  * Name:  nxsched_switch_running
121:  *
122:  * Description:
123:  *   This function switches the head of the current CPU's assigned tasks
124:  *   list to the TCB given as parameter. The idle task is not switched out.
125:  *   If the running task can't be swapped out, the btcb is pushed to
126:  *   the ready-to-run list.
127:  *
128:  * Input Parameters:
129:  *   cpu          - Always this_cpu(). Given as argument only for
130:  *                  optimization
131:  *   switch_equal - When true, switch away a task of equal priority compared
132:  *                  to the pending one
133:  *
134:  * Returned Value:
135:  *   true if the currently active task is switched
136:  *
137:  * Assumptions:
138:  * - The caller has established a critical section
139:  * - The caller has already removed the input rtcb from whatever list it
140:  *   was in.
141:  * - The caller handles the condition that occurs if the head of the
142:  *   assigned tasks list has changed.
143:  *
144:  ****************************************************************************/
145: 
146: bool nxsched_switch_running(int cpu, bool switch_equal)
147: {
148:   FAR struct tcb_s *rtcb = current_task(cpu);
149:   int sched_priority = rtcb->sched_priority;
150:   FAR struct tcb_s *btcb;
151:   bool ret = false;
152: 
153:   DEBUGASSERT(cpu == this_cpu());
154: 
155:   if (nxsched_islocked_tcb(rtcb))
156:     {
157:       return false;
158:     }
159: 
160:   if (switch_equal && sched_priority > 0)
161:     {
162:       sched_priority--;
163:     }
164: 
165:   /* If there is a task in readytorun list, which is eglible to run on this
166:    * CPU, and has higher priority than the current task,
167:    * switch the current task to that one.
168:    */
169: 
170:   for (btcb = (FAR struct tcb_s *)dq_peek(list_readytorun());
171:        btcb && btcb->sched_priority > sched_priority;
172:        btcb = btcb->flink)
173:     {
174:       /* Check if the task found in ready-to-run list is allowed to run on
175:        * this CPU. TCB_FLAG_CPU_LOCKED may be used to override affinity. If
176:        * the flag is set, assume that btcb->cpu is valid, and it is the only
177:        * CPU on which the btcb can run.
178:        */
179: 
180:       if (CPU_ISSET(cpu, &btcb->affinity) &&
181:           ((btcb->flags & TCB_FLAG_CPU_LOCKED) == 0 || btcb->cpu == cpu))
182:         {
183:           /* Found a task, remove it from ready-to-run list */
184: 
185:           dq_rem((FAR struct dq_entry_s *)btcb, list_readytorun());
186: 
187:           if (!is_idle_task(rtcb))
188:             {
189:               /* Put currently running task back to ready-to-run list */
190: 
191:               rtcb->task_state = TSTATE_TASK_READYTORUN;
192:               nxsched_add_prioritized(rtcb, list_readytorun());
193:             }
194:           else
195:             {
196:               rtcb->task_state = TSTATE_TASK_ASSIGNED;
197:             }
198: 
199:           per_cpu_var_smp(g_assignedtasks, cpu) = btcb;
200:           up_update_task(btcb);
201: 
202:           btcb->cpu = cpu;
203:           btcb->task_state = TSTATE_TASK_RUNNING;
204:           ret = true;
205:           break;
206:         }
207:     }
208: 
209:   return ret;
210: }

212: /****************************************************************************
213:  * Name:  nxsched_add_readytorun
214:  *
215:  * Description:
216:  *   This function adds a TCB to one of the ready to run lists. The list
217:  *   will be:
218:  *
219:  *   1. The g_readytorun list if the task is ready-to-run but not running
220:  *      and not assigned to a CPU.
221:  *   2. The g_assignedtask[cpu] list if the task is running or if has been
222:  *      assigned to a CPU.
223:  *
224:  *   If the currently active task has preemption disabled and the new TCB
225:  *   would cause this task to be pre-empted, the new task is added to the
226:  *   g_pendingtasks list instead.  The pending tasks will be made
227:  *   ready-to-run when preemption isunlocked.

229:  * Input Parameters:
230:  *   btcb - Points to the blocked TCB that is ready-to-run
231:  *
232:  * Returned Value:
233:  *   true if the currently active task (the head of the ready-to-run list)
234:  *   has changed.

236:  * Assumptions:
237:  * - The caller has established a critical section before calling this
238:  *   function (calling sched_lock() first is NOT a good idea -- use
239:  *   enter_critical_section()).
240:  * - The caller has already removed the input rtcb from whatever list it
241:  *   was in.
242:  * - The caller handles the condition that occurs if the head of the
243:  *   ready-to-run list has changed.
244:  *
245:  ****************************************************************************/
246: 
247: bool nxsched_add_readytorun(FAR struct tcb_s *btcb)
248: {
249:   bool doswitch = false;
250:   int target_cpu = btcb->flags & TCB_FLAG_CPU_LOCKED ? btcb->cpu :
251:     nxsched_select_cpu(btcb->affinity);
252:   FAR struct tcb_s *tcb = current_task(target_cpu);
253: 
254:   /* Add the btcb to the ready to run list, and try to run it on the target
255:    * CPU
256:    */
257: 
258:   btcb->task_state = TSTATE_TASK_READYTORUN;
259:   nxsched_add_prioritized(btcb, list_readytorun());
260: 
261:   /* In some cases, such as setaffinity, cpu need to be used. */
262: 
263:   btcb->cpu = target_cpu;
264:   if (tcb->sched_priority < btcb->sched_priority)
265:     {
266:       doswitch = nxsched_deliver_task(this_cpu(), target_cpu,
267:                                       SWITCH_HIGHER);
268:     }
269: 
270:   return doswitch;
271: }

42: /****************************************************************************
43:  * Name: nxsched_set_affinity
44:  *
45:  * Description:
46:  *   sched_setaffinity() sets the CPU affinity mask of the thread whose ID
47:  *   is pid to the value specified by mask.  If pid is zero, then the
48:  *   calling thread is used.  The argument cpusetsize is the length (i
49:  *   bytes) of the data pointed to by mask.  Normally this argument would
50:  *   be specified as sizeof(cpu_set_t).
51:  *
52:  *   If the thread specified by pid is not currently running on one of the
53:  *   CPUs specified in mask, then that thread is migrated to one of the
54:  *   CPUs specified in mask.
55:  *
56:  *   nxsched_set_affinity() is identical to the function sched_setparam(),
57:  *   differing only in its return value:  This function does not modify
58:  *   the errno variable.  This is a non-standard, internal OS function and
59:  *   is not intended for use by application logic.  Applications should
60:  *   use the standard sched_setparam().
61:  *
62:  * Input Parameters:
63:  *   pid        - The ID of thread whose affinity set will be modified.
64:  *   cpusetsize - Size of mask.  MUST be sizeofcpu_set_t().
65:  *   mask       - The location to return the thread's new affinity set.
66:  *
67:  * Returned Value:
68:  *   Zero (OK) if successful.  Otherwise, a negated errno value is returned:
69:  *
70:  *     ESRCH  The task whose ID is pid could not be found.
71:  *
72:  ****************************************************************************/
73: 
74: int nxsched_set_affinity(pid_t pid, size_t cpusetsize,
75:                          FAR const cpu_set_t *mask)
76: {
77:   FAR struct tcb_s *tcb;
78:   irqstate_t flags;
79:   int ret = OK;
80: 
81:   DEBUGASSERT(cpusetsize == sizeof(cpu_set_t) && mask != NULL);
82: 
83:   /* Make sure that affinity mask is valid */
84: 
85:   if (*mask == 0)
86:     {
87:       return -EINVAL;
88:     }
89: 
90:   /* Verify that the PID corresponds to a real task */
91: 
92:   if (!pid)
93:     {
94:       tcb = this_task();
95:     }
96:   else
97:     {
98:       tcb = nxsched_get_tcb(pid);
99:     }
100: 
101:   if (tcb == NULL)
102:     {
103:       ret = -ESRCH;
104:       goto errout;
105:     }
106: 
107:   /* Don't permit changing the affinity mask of any task locked to a CPU
108:    * (i.e., an IDLE task)
109:    */
110: 
111:   flags = enter_critical_section();
112:   if ((atomic_read(&tcb->flags) & TCB_FLAG_CPU_LOCKED) != 0)
113:     {
114:       ret = -EINVAL;
115:       goto errout_with_csection;
116:     }
117: 
118:   /* Set the new affinity mask. */
119: 
120:   tcb->affinity = *mask;
121: 
122:   /* Is the task still executing a a CPU in its affinity mask? Will this
123:    * change cause the task to be removed from its current assigned task
124:    * list?
125:    *
126:    * First... is the task in an assigned task list?
127:    */
128: 
129:   if (tcb->task_state >= FIRST_READY_TO_RUN_STATE &&
130:       tcb->task_state <= LAST_READY_TO_RUN_STATE)
131:     {
132:       /* Yes... is the CPU associated with the assigned task in the new
133:        * affinity mask?
134:        */
135: 
136:       if ((tcb->affinity & (1 << tcb->cpu)) == 0)
137:         {
138:           /* No.. then we will need to move the task from the assigned
139:            * task list to some other ready to run list.
140:            *
141:            * nxsched_set_priority() will do just what we want... it will
142:            * remove the task from its current position in the some assigned
143:            * task list and then simply put it back in the right place.  This
144:            * works even if the task is this task.
145:            */
146: 
147:           ret = nxsched_set_priority(tcb, tcb->sched_priority);
148:         }
149:     }
150: 
151: errout_with_csection:
152:   leave_critical_section(flags);
153:   if (pid)
154:     {
155:       nxsched_put_tcb(tcb);
156:     }
157: 
158: errout:
159:   return ret;
160: }

167:  *   is pid to the value specified by mask.  If pid is zero, then the
168:  *   calling thread is used.  The argument cpusetsize is the length (i
169:  *   bytes) of the data pointed to by mask.  Normally this argument would
170:  *   be specified as sizeof(cpu_set_t).

173:  *   CPUs specified in mask, then that thread is migrated to one of the
174:  *   CPUs specified in mask.

176:  *   This function is a simply wrapper around nxsched_set_affinity() that
177:  *   sets the errno value in the event of an error.
178:  *
179:  * Input Parameters:

181:  *   cpusetsize - Size of mask.  MUST be sizeofcpu_set_t().

183:  *
184:  * Returned Value:

186:  *   set appropriately:

189:  *
190:  ****************************************************************************/

516: {
517:   uint8_t minprio;
518:   int cpu;
519:   int i;

521:   minprio = SCHED_PRIORITY_MAX;
522:   cpu     = 0xff;
523: 
524:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; i++)
525:     {
526:       /* Is the thread permitted to run on this CPU? */
527: 
528:       if ((affinity & (1 << i)) != 0)
529:         {
530:           FAR struct tcb_s *rtcb = current_task(i);
531: 
532:           /* If this CPU is executing its IDLE task, then use it.  The
533:            * IDLE task is always the last task in the assigned task list.
534:            */
535: 
536:           if (is_idle_task(rtcb))
537:             {
538:               /* The IDLE task should always be assigned to this CPU and have
539:                * a priority of zero.
540:                */
541: 
542:               DEBUGASSERT(rtcb->sched_priority == 0);

76:     {
77:       /* Manage the (rare) case that task delivery to this CPU was not
78:        * successful. This can happen in two cases:
79:        * 1) The currently running task on this CPU just entered sched_lock
80:        * 2) This CPU just picked a higher priority task to execute
81:        *    before this SMP call was executed
82:        * To avoid schedule latency/priority inversion, just check once more
83:        * if there is another CPU eglible to run the delivered task, and
84:        * pass it forward.

91:             tcb->cpu : nxsched_select_cpu(tcb->affinity);
92:           if (target_cpu != cpu &&
93:               current_task(target_cpu)->sched_priority < tcb->sched_priority)
94:             {
95:               nxsched_deliver_task(cpu, target_cpu, priority);

497: ### 6.2 文件与构建接入
498: 
499: 建议最小新增：
500: 
501: ```text
502: chips/bk7258/
503:   bk7258_cpustart.c       # secondary vector、reset、online handshake
504:   bk7258_cpuindex.c       # logical CPU ID
505:   bk7258_cpuidlestack.c   # secondary idle stack
506:   bk7258_idle.c           # P0 WFI；P1调用NuttX pm_idle
507:   bk7258_smpcall.c        # raw Mailbox IPI
508:   bk7258_hwspinlock.c     # AP_SPINLOCK software gate
509:   bk7258_atomic.c         # g_atomic_hwspinlock
510: ```
511: 
512: 修改：
513: 
514: ```text
515: Kconfig
516: CMakeLists.txt
517: Make.defs
518: bk7258_start.c
519: bk7258_vectors.c
520: bk7258_irq.c
521: bk7258_timerisr.c
522: bk7258_mbox0.c
523: bk7258_mailbox_channel.c
524: hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h
525: hardware/bk7258_mbox.h
526: board scripts/ld.script
527: board configs/nsh/defconfig
528: ```
529: 
530: Make和CMake必须包含同一组SMP源文件，并仅在 `CONFIG_SMP` 下编译专用对象。
531: 
532: ### 6.3 CPU ID
533: 
534: 原厂 AP 使用每核私有 DTCM地址 `0x20000000` 保存 AP逻辑核 ID。OpenVela采用：
535: 
536: ```text
537: 物理CPU1私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU0
538: 物理CPU2私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU1
539: ```
540: 
541: `up_cpu_index()` 直接读取该word。primary在任何 per-CPU/NuttX atomic调用前写0；
542: secondary在任何NuttX API前写1。必须实板验证两核看到的是私有实例，不是共享word。
543: 
544: ### 6.4 内存、secondary vector和栈
545: 
546: 分区保持：
547: 
548: ```text
549: AP_SPINLOCK  0x28000000..0x2800ffff
550: AP_RAM       0x28010000..0x28063fff
551: CP_RAM       0x28064000..0x2809f6ff
552: PWR_MNG      0x2809f700..0x2809f7ff
553: SWAP         0x2809f800..0x2809ffff
554: ```
555: 
556: CPU2不增加Flash/RAM分区。链接脚本增加：
557: 
558: - `SPINLOCK` MEMORY，绝不加入heap。
559: - 512字节对齐的 `.bk_secondary_vectors`。
560: - 只用于reset早期的CPU2 bootstrap stack。
561: - 两份静态 interrupt stack，或等价的每核固定中断栈区域。
562: - 全部边界和对齐 `ASSERT`。
563: 
564: secondary vector：
565: 
566: ```text
567: word 0: CPU2 bootstrap MSP top
568: word 1: bk7258_secondary_start | 1
569: ```
570: 
571: CPU2 boot offset寄存器只保存地址高24位，至少要求256字节对齐；统一采用512字节以
572: 满足VTOR约束。secondary vector不包含primary image offset `0x100` 的BK legacy magic。
573: 
574: `up_cpu_idlestack()` 应像RP2040一样调用 `up_create_stack()`，初始化logical CPU1 idle
575: TCB。还必须分配 `CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS * INTSTACK_SIZE` 对齐空间并实现
576: `uintptr_t up_get_intstackbase(int cpu)`；公共ARM实现只覆盖UP构建，ARMv8-M任务初始状态
577: 会调用该hook。CPU2 reset后先用bootstrap MSP；进入NuttX前将PSP切到idle TCB stack
578: top，调用 `arm_initialize_stack()` 安装本核MSP/MSPLIM interrupt stack。两个核不得共用
579: MSP。
580: 
581: ### 6.5 CPU2启动
582: 
583: `up_cpu_start(1)`：
584: 
585: ```text
586: 校验cpu==1且当前为logical CPU0
587:   -> 确认CP的OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold和domain readback均为ON
588:   -> 确认480 MHz契约和channel 2已配置
589:   -> 发布idle PSP、interrupt MSP、runtime VTOR
590:   -> 清boot stage/online flag，DMB/DSB
591:   -> CPU2保持reset时清route/pending
592:   -> CPU2_RXEVT_SEL=1
593:   -> CPU2_OFFSET=secondary_vector>>8
594:   -> cpu2_release_reset()（极性已由run-status/实板验证）
595:   -> 有界等待online和双向IPI自检
596: ```
597: 
598: 超时建议500 ms，输出CPU2 control、run status、route、NVIC、Mailbox channel 2、boot
599: stage和当前频率readback，然后panic。不能只返回错误后继续 `nx_bringup()`。
600: 
601: `bk7258_secondary_start()` 只初始化每核私有状态：
602: 
603: - logical ID、FPU CP10/11和barrier。
604: - 与primary一致的SAU/MPU/VTOR。
605: - CPU2私有NVIC enable/pending/priority。
606: - CPU2 Mailbox route和IRQ79。
607: - PSP/MSP/stack limit。
608: - release-ordered online flag、可选的 `sched_note_cpu_started(this_task())`、
609:   `nx_idle_trampoline()`。
610: 
611: primary以acquire语义等待online flag。`sched_note_cpu_started()`只是可选trace，在note
612: driver未启用时为空，不能承担online handshake。
613: 
614: secondary禁止复制 `.data`、清 `.bss`、初始化heap/PSRAM/driver、调用 `nx_start()`、
615: 初始化第二个SysTick或重置全局Mailbox FIFO。
616: 
617: ### 6.6 每核MPU/NVIC
618: 
619: MPU、SAU、NVIC、VTOR、SysTick和FPU控制均为每核私有。CPU2必须安装与CPU1相同的：
620: 
621: - AP Flash RO/X。
622: - AP RAM RW/XN/shareable。
623: - `AP_SPINLOCK` RW/XN/non-cacheable/shareable。
624: - CP共享窗口和Mailbox UART override。
625: - PSRAM 16 MiB RW/XN/non-cacheable。
626: - peripheral Device/XN。
627: 
628: 当前 CPU1 使用7个 MPU region；增加 AP_SPINLOCK 后至少需要8个，启动时继续读
629: `MPU_TYPE.DREGION`并 fail-stop。CPU2不能重复probe或初始化PSRAM allocator。
630: 
631: 全局NuttX IRQ table只由primary初始化一次。CPU2只初始化私有NVIC和CPU2 route：
632: 
633: ```text
634: CPU1 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010088 / 0x4401008c
635: CPU2 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010090 / 0x44010094
636: ```
637: 
638: 首版只有CPU2 Mailbox IPI路由到CPU2。GPIO、PWM、I2C、QSPI、camera、Wi-Fi和其他
639: 有状态外设仍由logical CPU0 owner。
640: 
641: ## 7. Mailbox IPI与CP transport共存
642: 
643: ### 7.1 物理channel
644: 
645: | channel | owner | FIFO |
646: | ---: | --- | --- |
647: | 0 | CPU0/CP | start 0, length 2 |
648: | 1 | CPU1/AP primary | start 2, length 3 |
649: | 2 | CPU2/AP secondary | start 5, length 3 |
650: 
651: 沿用原厂消息分类：
652: 
653: ```text
654: data[1] != 0: pointer + length envelope，进入CP/AP logical transport
655: data[1] == 0: AP内部raw command，进入SMP IPI handler
656: ```
657: 
658: CPU2不处理CP PWC、heartbeat、Wi-Fi或Mailbox UART envelope。CP transport始终由
659: logical CPU0负责。
660: 
661: ### 7.2 当前初始化路径的改造
662: 
663: 当前 physical Mailbox 已在 `arm_serialinit()` 中经：
664: 
665: ```text
666: bk7258_mailbox_init()
667: bk7258_mb_uart_init()
668: bk7258_mailbox_start()
669: ```
670: 
671: 启动。这发生在 `nx_smp_start()` 之前，生命周期适合SMP。改造要求：
672: 
673: 1. primary physical start一次性配置channel 1和2 FIFO，不能在CPU2 online后soft reset。
674: 2. 全局 `irq_attach(79, ...)` 只执行一次；CPU2复用共享NuttX IRQ handler table，但启用
675:    自己的route和私有NVIC line 63。
676: 3. ISR按 `up_cpu_index()` 选择本核physical channel。
677: 4. channel 1可处理CP envelope和raw IPI；channel 2只接受raw IPI。
678: 5. shared transport状态从仅 `up_irq_save()` 改为SMP spinlock，或严格固定到CPU0。
679: 
680: ### 7.3 NuttX SMP hooks
681: 
682: 实现：
683: 
684: ```c
685: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu);
686: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset);
687: ```
688: 
689: raw command采用pending bitmap合并 `SCHED`、`CALL`和 `PM`。发送前DMB，ISR读取并清
690: pending后DMB，然后调用：
691: 
692: ```c
693: nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, arg);
694: nxsched_process_delivered(this_cpu());
695: ```
696: 
697: FIFO full不能静默丢失。采用“shared pending bit + kick”语义：消息只负责唤醒，真实
698: 工作由pending bit保持；如果目标已有未处理kick，不重复占FIFO。发送失败需要有界重试、
699: 计数和fatal门限，禁止持有目标ISR需要的spinlock时无限等待。
700: 
701: ## 8. Atomic、spinlock和共享驱动
702: 
703: ### 8.1 BK7258约束
704: 
705: 原厂注释明确：BK7258 AP SMP只有两个exclusive monitor；两个CPU同时对普通SRAM做
706: exclusive访问时，第三方DMA/Audio写SRAM可能无提示失败。因此原厂把所有spinlock对象
707: 集中在 `AP_SPINLOCK` 特殊SRAM区。
708: 
709: `AP_SPINLOCK`不是寄存器型硬件spinlock。首版使用一个位于该区的software gate，
710: 通过LDAXR/STXR仲裁NuttX `atomic_*` 和libc out-of-line atomic helper：
711: 
712: ```text
713: CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK=y
714: g_atomic_hwspinlock -> struct hwspinlock_dev_s -> BK7258 software gate
715: ```
716: 
717: gate owner使用 `logical_cpu + 1`，0表示free，避免CPU0 owner和free混淆。trylock使用
718: acquire exclusive，unlock使用release store、DSB和SEV。primary在进入 `nx_start()` 前
719: 初始化gate；CPU2启动后禁止再次清零。
720: 
721: 这不会自动拦截编译器内联 `__atomic_*`、`__sync_*` 或手写exclusive loop。SMP源码禁止
722: 直接使用这些路径，构建时反汇编全部SMP对象，除approved gate外发现LDREX/STREX或
723: LDAXR/STXR循环即失败。只有DMA/Audio/exclusive压力通过后才能评估更细粒度方案。
724: 
725: ### 8.2 驱动收敛
726: 
727: 首版将以下worker和IRQ固定到logical CPU0：
728: 
729: - Mailbox transport/UART/syslog/PWC/heartbeat。
730: - Wi-Fi、camera、QSPI、DMA和媒体worker。
731: - GPIO、button/motor、PWM、I2C。
732: - 所有未完成SMP审计的board driver。
733: 
734: worker入口在访问任何driver状态前先构造 `CPU_ZERO/CPU_SET(0)` mask，并调用
735: `sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpu_set_t), &cpuset)`；成功后才通知creator ready。creator
736: 等待该ready，affinity失败则driver bring-up失败。不能在 `kthread_create()` 返回后才pin，
737: 因为worker可能已经运行。
738: 
739: 即使worker固定CPU0，CPU2任务仍可能调用公共API。以下共享状态必须使用
740: `spin_lock_irqsave()` 或mutex：
741: 
742: - Mailbox active transaction、ACK pool、recovery epoch和ring index。
743: - syslog/serial TX/RX ring。
744: - GPIO/PWM/I2C寄存器RMW。
745: - PSRAM allocator状态、allocation counters和generation。
746: - Wi-Fi command/data slot和pbuf ownership。
747: 
748: ISR共享短状态使用spinlock；会等待ACK、semaphore、内存或格式化日志的路径使用mutex，
749: 禁止在spinlock内sleep。
750: 
751: ## 9. 系统tick、heartbeat与时间正确性
752: 
753: 首版只有logical CPU0启动SysTick。CPU2不得调用 `up_timer_initialize()`，否则系统时间
754: 和RR accounting加倍。CPU0每tick调用NuttX timer处理，调度器通过IPI要求CPU2切换。
755: 
756: 必须满足：
757: 
758: - `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`。
759: - CPU1实际频率和 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000` 一致。
760: - 60秒wall clock测试误差在晶振/调度允许范围内，不能出现2倍或1/2倍。
761: - heartbeat实际周期约2秒，不是4秒。
762: - heartbeat发送返回值必须检查并统计 `-EBUSY`、`-ENOLINK`、timeout。
763: - CP heartbeat使用实际 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 配置；timeout至少容纳调度抖动和一次transport
764:   recovery，但不能用增大timeout掩盖lost heartbeat。
765: 
766: 长期测试必须跨越旧故障边界：至少运行3小时；正式验收运行24小时。还应通过调试构建
767: 把timer timebase置于旧的 `UINT32_MAX / 1000` 边界前，快速验证sleep跨界。
768:
